A plain long wooden bow, with a visibly straight taut bowstring when relaxed and curved limbs, long arrows. Match knight's painted detail and human realism. Camera: orthographic shallow18-degree elevation, STRICT LEFT SIDE PROFILE, looking and moving to screen-left; see leftward nose silhouette and one side of torso; NO right-facing poses, same facing in ALL44cells. ROW2 four COMBAT IDLE breathing poses, weapon prepared forward at chest height.
ROWS3-4 EIGHT-frame natural NEUTRAL WALK loop, alternate left/right heel contact, loading, toe off, passing foot, normal modest stride, credible knee flexion.
ROWS5-6 EIGHT-frame natural COMBAT WALK loop, keep weapon in raised ready guard while feet alternate; never revert to weapon dangling at thigh.

Articulated fall not rigid upright rotation. Fixed camera and facing, full silhouettes. Rows are chronological left to right; no omitted cells.
